messages.author: 3e760f21bbbda44e
messages.subject: How to alter position of shinyIncubator progress bar
parts:
Hello shiny people,

I'm implementing a progress bar as described here: http://stackoverflow.com/a/18624844/2687824

Currently the progress bar appears in the upper-right corner of the page, where it is often off screen.

I want to put the progress bar in the center of the screen, so that it remains stationary 'above' the page as you scroll in the browser.  Failing that, I'd like to put it in the mainPanel area, where the user's attention will be while a plot is being generated.

Thanks!

messages.author: a58a2a3609db3342
messages.subject: Re: How to alter position of shinyIncubator progress bar
parts:
Hi christozoan,

I handled this sometime ago. It should be enough to use this css

.shiny-progress {
  top: 50% !important;
  left: 50% !important;
  margin-top: -100px !important;
  margin-left: -250px !important;
}

messages.author: a58a2a3609db3342
messages.subject: Re: How to alter position of shinyIncubator progress bar
parts:
In ui.R have a link to your style sheet 'styles.css' for example
 
  tags$link(rel = 'stylesheet', type = 'text/css', href = 'styles.css'),

"styles.css" should be in the www/ folder of your app and contain this code

.shiny-progress {
  top: 50% !important;
  left: 50% !important;
  margin-top: -100px !important;
  margin-left: -250px !important;
}

messages.subject: Re: How to alter position of shinyIncubator progress bar
parts:
ui.R looks like this:

library(shiny)
library(shinyIncubator)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("Seed"),
 
  tabsetPanel( 
    
    tabPanel("Data", 
      progressInit(), 
      sidebarPanel(
        #blah blah file input
      ),
 
      mainPanel(
        # display dataset info
      )
    ),
    
    # Histogram tab
    tabPanel("Histogram", 
      uiOutput("histVariableSelection"),
      mainPanel(    
        plotOutput("histPlot", height=plotHeight)
      )
    ),
    
    # Scatterplot tab
    tabPanel("Scatter",
      uiOutput("scatterVariableSelection"),
      mainPanel(
        plotOutput("scatterPlot", height=plotHeight)
      )
    ),
    
    # PCoA tab
    tabPanel("PCoA", 
             uiOutput("pcoaVariableSelection"),
             mainPanel(
                 plotOutput("pcoaPlot", height=plotHeight)
             )
    ),
    #### several more similar tabPanels
  ),
  mainPanel()
))

parts:
There is an example here https://gist.github.com/johndharrison/9578241 .

Save the ui.R and server.R in a directory and place the styles.css in a www/ directory.

library(shiny)
runApp()

from the directory ui.R and server.R are in will show the progress bar etc.
